body.zh-Hant: 德國國家圖書館的權威檔記載拉斐爾·雷耶斯生於1849年12月5日，並稱他是軍人與政治人物。哥倫比亞共和國銀行文化網路的百科條目寫明他生於聖羅莎德比特博，在波哥大去世。Gale 出版的《拉丁美洲歷史與文化百科全書》由理查·斯托勒撰寫條目，稱他是1904至1909年的哥倫比亞總統。卒日兩處記載不一：權威檔寫1921年2月19日，百科寫2月18日。
body.en: The German National Library authority record gives Rafael Reyes's birth as 5 December 1849 and calls him a soldier and politician. The Banco de la República cultural network's encyclopedia entry says he was born in Santa Rosa de Viterbo and died in Bogotá. The Encyclopedia of Latin American History and Culture (Gale), in an entry by Richard J. Stoller, calls him president of Colombia from 1904 to 1909. The sources differ on his death date: the authority record says 19 February 1921, the encyclopedias say 18 February.

citations.quote: Santa Rosa de Viterbo, diciembre 5 de 1849 - Bogotá, febrero 18 de 1921

body.zh-Hant: BanRep 條目說，雷耶斯從1868年起展開旅行與探勘生涯，並重新發現了普圖馬約河。《拉丁美洲歷史與文化百科全書》指出，他在1870年代的奎寧熱潮中賺得財富；1895年他率政府軍在桑坦德的恩西索作戰，百科認為這是他在保守黨內聲望的頂點。BanRep 說他贏得恩西索之役。百科又寫，千日戰爭期間他人在國外。
body.en: The BanRep entry says that from 1868 Reyes began a life of travel and exploration and rediscovered the Putumayo River. The Encyclopedia of Latin American History and Culture says he made a fortune in the quinine boom of the 1870s, and in 1895 led government forces at Enciso, Santander, which it treats as the peak of his prominence in the Conservative Party. BanRep says he won the battle of Enciso. The encyclopedia adds that he spent the War of the Thousand Days abroad.

citations.quote: a partir de 1868, iniciar su vida de viajero y descubridor
made a fortune in the quinine boom of the 1870s
led government forces at Enciso, Santander
peaked in 1895 when he led government forces at Enciso
ganó en la batalla de Enciso
sat out the War of the Thousand Days (1899–1902) abroad

heading.zh-Hant: 制憲議會、部長與外交職務
heading.en: Constituent council, minister and diplomatic posts

body.zh-Hant: BanRep 條目寫明，1885年11月11日國家制憲會議成立時，雷耶斯在其中占有一席；1887年，努涅斯任命他為興業部長。後來他被派為駐法國的全權公使，條目說這是卡羅為了讓他離開國內。1901年，他又出任在墨西哥舉行的美洲國際會議的代表。
body.en: The BanRep entry says that when the National Constituent Council was installed on 11 November 1885 Reyes took a seat in it, and that in 1887 Núñez named him minister of Fomento. He was later sent as minister plenipotentiary to France, which the entry says Caro arranged in order to keep him away from the country. In 1901 he was a delegate to the International American Conference held in Mexico.

citations.quote: cuando se instaló el Consejo Nacional Constituyente, Reyes ocupó una curul
Núñez nombró a Reyes ministro de Fomento
En 1887, al regreso de su malograda misión
Caro lo envió como ministro plenipotenciario a Francia para alejarlo del país
En 1901 fue delegado a la Conferencia Internacional Americana

body.zh-Hant: 《拉丁美洲歷史與文化百科全書》寫道，雷耶斯在1904年的一場舞弊不斷的選舉中贏得總統職位，並在1905年解散國會；他的施政被稱為 quinquenio。BanRep 條目說，他在1905年設立中央銀行，1907年創辦波哥大軍校，1908年把全國劃為34個省。條目又寫，他在1909年6月3日啟程出國，辭職於7月27日正式確定；百科則說這是在波哥大街頭示威之後。
body.en: The Encyclopedia of Latin American History and Culture says Reyes won the presidency in 1904 in a tight election plagued by fraud and dissolved Congress in 1905; his administration is known as the quinquenio. The BanRep entry says he created the Central Bank in 1905, founded the Military Cadet School in Bogotá in 1907, and divided the country into 34 departments in 1908. It adds that he set off on his journey on 3 June 1909 and that his resignation became official on 27 July; the encyclopedia ties his departure to street demonstrations in Bogotá.

citations.quote: In 1904 Reyes won the presidency in a tight election plagued by fraud
His administration, known as the quinquenio
en 1907 fundó la Escuela Militar de Cadetes de Bogotá
En 1908 dividió al país en 34 departamentos
Reyes emprendió viaje el 3 de junio
Su dimisión se oficializó el 27 de julio de 1909.
In June 1909, following street demonstrations in Bogotá

body.zh-Hant: 德國國家圖書館的權威檔把泰萊基·帕爾記為伯爵、教授、外交部長與總理，生於1879年11月1日，卒於1941年4月3日。匈牙利的《匈牙利傳記辭典》寫他是政治家、總理、地理學家、大學教授，也是匈牙利科學院院士；匈牙利科學院的紀念文件則說他生於布達佩斯。
body.en: The German National Library authority record describes Pál Teleki as a count, professor, foreign minister and prime minister, born on 1 November 1879 and died on 3 April 1941. The Hungarian Biographical Lexicon calls him a politician, prime minister, geographer and university professor and a member of the Hungarian Academy of Sciences, and a memorial document of the Academy says he was born in Budapest.

citations.quote: politikus miniszterelnök, földrajztudós, egyetemi tanár, az MTA tagja

body.zh-Hant: 《匈牙利傳記辭典》記載，他1904年在薩特馬爾縣任縣吏，1905至1910年、1915至1918年是憲法黨議員，1909至1913年擔任地理研究所所長。匈牙利科學院的文件補充說，他1905年首次在納吉索姆庫特選區當選，1906年再度當選。
body.en: The Hungarian Biographical Lexicon records that in 1904 he was a district official in Szatmár county, that he sat as a Constitution Party deputy in 1905–1910 and 1915–1918, and that he directed the Geographical Institute in 1909–1913. The Academy's memorial document adds that he was first elected in 1905 in the Nagysomkút constituency and elected again in 1906.

citations.quote: Először 1905-ben választották meg a nagysomkúti kerületben

body.zh-Hant: 《匈牙利傳記辭典》寫他在1919年5月3日至8月12日的塞格德政府中擔任文化部長與外交部長，1920年4月19日起任西莫尼—塞瑪達姆政府的外交部長，7月19日至1921年4月13日任總理，並在9月22日前兼任外交部長。條目又說他任內讓議會批准了特里亞農和約，並使反猶的入學限額法通過，第一次國王復辟政變後他辭職。
body.en: The Hungarian Biographical Lexicon says he was culture and foreign minister in the Szeged government from 3 May to 12 August 1919, became foreign minister in the Simonyi-Semadam government on 19 April 1920, and was prime minister from 19 July 1920 to 13 April 1921, also serving as foreign minister until 22 September. It adds that he had the Treaty of Trianon ratified, secured passage of the anti-Jewish numerus clausus law, and resigned after the first royalist coup attempt.

citations.quote: kultusz-, ill. külügyminiszter (1919. máj. 3-tól aug. 12- ig)

heading.zh-Hant: 上議院、教育部長與第二次組閣
heading.en: Upper house, education minister and second premiership

body.zh-Hant: 《匈牙利傳記辭典》記載，他1927至1938年是上議院議員，1938年5月14日起在伊姆雷迪政府任宗教與公共教育部長，1939年2月16日第二度出任總理，至1941年4月3日。條目寫他加入反共產國際協定，並說他在1941年3月貝爾格勒政變後自殺，留給霍爾蒂的告別信譴責對南斯拉夫的行動。
body.en: The Hungarian Biographical Lexicon records that he was a member of the upper house from 1927 to 1938, minister of religion and public education in the Imrédy government from 14 May 1938, and prime minister for a second time from 16 February 1939 to 3 April 1941. It says he joined the Anti-Comintern Pact, and that after the Belgrade coup of March 1941 he killed himself, condemning the action against Yugoslavia in a farewell letter to Horthy.

body.zh-Hant: 《新德意志人物傳》（NDB）記載赫爾曼·勞施寧1887年8月7日生於西普魯士的托恩，1982年2月8日卒於美國波特蘭，是政治人物與政論作者。他1906年起在慕尼黑和柏林讀日耳曼學、歷史與音樂學，第一次世界大戰時當軍官，負重傷返鄉後成為農場主，1926年移居但澤自由市境內務農。
body.en: The Neue Deutsche Biographie (NDB) records Hermann Rauschning as born on 7 August 1887 in Thorn, West Prussia, and died on 8 February 1982 in Portland, Oregon, a politician and publicist. From 1906 he studied German studies, history and musicology in Munich and Berlin, served as an officer in the First World War, returned badly wounded and became a farmer, and in 1926 settled as a farmer on the territory of the Free City of Danzig.

citations.quote: studierte seit 1906 Germanistik, Geschichte und Musikwissenschaft
Am 1. Weltkrieg nahm er als Offizier teil
kehrte schwer verwundet zurück und wurde dann Landwirt
1926 ließ er sich als Landwirt auf dem Gebiet der Freien Stadt Danzig nieder

heading.zh-Hant: 加入納粹黨與但澤土地聯盟
heading.en: Joining the Nazi Party and the Danzig Landbund

body.zh-Hant: NDB 寫他1932年加入納粹黨，同年成為但澤土地聯盟（Landbund）的主席。《當代史季刊》上索代卡特的文章說他先前屬於但澤的德意志民族人民黨。NDB 又記載，1933年5月選舉後，納粹黨在人民議會取得72席中的38席，勞施寧從6月起以參議院議長身分，領導由納粹黨與中央黨組成的聯合內閣。
body.en: The NDB says he joined the Nazi Party in 1932 and in that year became chairman of the Danzig Landbund. Ernst Sodeikat's article in the Vierteljahrshefte für Zeitgeschichte says he had earlier belonged to the Danzig German National People's Party. The NDB adds that after the May 1933 election the Nazi Party held 38 of 72 seats in the Volkstag, and from June Rauschning governed as president of the Senate with a coalition cabinet of the Nazi Party and the Centre Party.

citations.quote: 1932 wurde er Vorsitzender des Danziger Landbundes
früher der Danziger Deutschnationalen Volkspartei zugehörigen
regierte R. seit dem Juni als Senatspräsident

heading.zh-Hant: 參議院議長任內與辭職
heading.en: Term as Senate president and resignation

body.zh-Hant: NDB 寫他任內推動但澤農業減債，1933年秋天促成與波蘭的協議，賦予波蘭少數群體廣泛權利。後來地方黨領袖福斯特介入他的權限而爆發衝突；索代卡特的文章說，他在1934年11月22日被納粹黨團書面表示不信任後，於11月23日宣布辭職，由副議長格賴澤接任。
body.en: The NDB says that in office he promoted debt relief for Danzig agriculture and in autumn 1933 brought about an agreement with Poland granting the Polish minority far-reaching rights. Conflict followed when Gauleiter Albert Forster interfered in his powers. Sodeikat's article says that after the Nazi group in the Volkstag expressed written no confidence on 22 November 1934, he announced his resignation on 23 November, and that Senate vice president Arthur Greiser succeeded him.

citations.quote: Es gelang ihm, die Entschuldung der Danziger Landwirtschaft zu fördern.
brachte er im Herbst 1933 ein Abkommen mit Polen zustande
der Gauleiter Albert Forster (1902–52) in R. s Kompetenzen eingriff
Nach einem Mißtrauensvotum im Volksrat am 22.11.1934 trat R. zurück.
Sein Nachfolger wurde der Nationalsozialist Arthur Greiser

body.zh-Hant: NDB 記載，勞施寧於1936年秋天經波蘭逃到瑞士，1938年轉往法國，最後到英國；1938年他的主要著作《虛無主義革命》在蘇黎世出版，1941年他移居美國，1948年在波特蘭附近當農夫。條目也說他的《與希特勒的談話》在史料上有爭議。
body.en: The NDB records that in autumn 1936 Rauschning fled via Poland to Switzerland, then went to France in 1938 and finally to England; in 1938 his main work, Die Revolution des Nihilismus, appeared in Zurich. In 1941 he emigrated to the United States and in 1948 settled near Portland, Oregon, as a farmer. The entry also says his Gespräche mit Hitler is disputed as a source.
